text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: We'll take you down no matter how many times you come back!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんかい出てきたって結果は同じだよ！

text_block_list.name: Rei
text_block_list.text: If words aren't enough, then we'll beat it into you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
理解できないなら、
その体に刻んでやる……！

text_block_list.name: Yui
text_block_list.text: We won't lose, no matter what!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わたしたちは、
あなたには負けない！
